classification.difficultyReason: Use the shared door and panel width, convert scaled dimensions, and calculate area.

content.prompt: A plan of a large ornamental doorway is drawn to a scale of $1:50$. The doorway is $8\text{ cm}$ wide on the plan. Above the door is a rectangular panel, whose base equals the width of the door, and whose height is $2\text{ cm}$ on the plan.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Calculate the width of the actual door and the height of the actual panel.

answer.short: Door width: $4\text{ m}$; panel height: $1\text{ m}$.
answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Actual door width}&=8\times50\text{ cm}\\\text{Actual door width}&=400\text{ cm}=4\text{ m}\\\text{Actual panel height}&=2\times50\text{ cm}\\\text{Actual panel height}&=100\text{ cm}=1\text{ m}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Calculate the area of the actual panel.

answer.worked:
The panel's base equals the door's width, $4\text{ m}$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Panel area}&=4\times1\text{ m}^2\\\text{Panel area}&=4\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$
